description: Nelson Bernard Hettiarachchi v. S.B. Bandusena, Secretary of the Ministry of Fisheries Nelson Bernard Hettiarachchi v. S.B. Bandusena, Secretary of the Ministry of Fisheries View More before Hon. K.T. Chitrasiri, J.
parties: Nelson Bernard Hettiarachchi v. S.B. Bandusena, Secretary of the Ministry of Fisheries Nelson Bernard Hettiarachchi v. S.B. Bandusena, Secretary of the Ministry of Fisheries View More
keywords: Sought to set aside judgement of revision application in the High Court affirming Magistrate’s order of writ of possession of premises in application filed in terms of Government Quarters (Recovery of Possession) Act No.7 of 1969 (as amended); necessity to consider merits of the case prior to issuing writ; Section 7(1) of the Act and Section 7(2)(b) in Amending Act No. 45 of 1985. Held - Appeal dismissed with costs. Leave to Appeal refused.
legistation: Article 154P(6) of the Constitution read with Rule 2(1) of the Court of Appeal (Procedure for Appeals from the High Court established by Article 154P of the Constitution) Rules 1998; Government Quarters (Recovery of Possession) Act No.7 of 1969 (as amended)
